mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) indicates inflationary pressures that may lead to tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases > 1% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it suggests inflationary pressure that may lead to tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with high interest rates
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates strong labor market conditions, which can lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real final sales of domestic product (RSAFS) indicates growing consumer demand, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) during a period of low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2%) signals accommodative monetary policy, which can lead to increased investment and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with low inflation
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL < 2% and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.
